messages:
Add JSON Pointer resolution (RFC 6901)

resolvePointer(document, pointer) returns the referenced value and throws
InvalidPointerError for bad syntax or UnresolvablePointerError when the
pointer does not resolve; both extend JsonPointerError. parsePointer is
exported for the features that will build on pointers.
